x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item.body: 1. Fit-to-standard decision (ae.fit evidence attached) 2. Create scoped app (AES or now-sdk init); repository connected 3. Tables, fields, choices, properties 4. Roles and ACLs (persona matrix) + ATF access tests 5. Flows and notifications + ATF critical path 6. Record producer / portal; workspace 7. Import set for legacy data; reconciliation 8. Dashboard, menus, modules 9. Publish to app repository; install in test; run ATF; UAT 10. Production install; PVT; register owner and support model Tip: stage 6 "Solution design" in this workbench can seed the component list via the greenfield skeleton.
